tools.name: video_info
tools.description:
Inspect a video or audio file: duration, resolution, frame rate, codecs, and whether it has audio.
    url: public http(s) URL of the file (or an output_url from another tool here).

tools.name: video_trim
tools.description:
Cut a clip out of a video (frame-accurate). start_s / end_s are seconds from the beginning.
    Returns an MP4 (H.264/AAC) output_url.

tools.name: video_concat
tools.description:
Join 2-10 videos end to end into one MP4. Clips are scaled/letterboxed to one size: the first clip's
    size unless width/height are given. Clips without audio get silence so the result always has a track.

tools.name: video_resize
tools.description:
Resize or reframe a video. Either aspect = "9:16" (Shorts/Reels/TikTok), "16:9", "1:1", "4:5", "4:3",
    or an explicit width and height. mode = "crop" (fill the frame, trim edges) or "pad" (fit inside, black bars).

tools.name: video_caption
tools.description:
Burn a text caption/title into a video (white text on a translucent dark box).
    position = "top", "center" or "bottom". font_size 0 = auto (about 1/18 of the frame height).
    start_s/end_s (optional) limit when the text shows; default is the whole video. Up to 300 characters;
    use \n for lin

tools.name: video_speed
tools.description:
Speed a video up or slow it down. factor 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed (0.25-4.0).
    Audio pitch is preserved.

tools.name: video_convert
tools.description:
Convert media to another format. format = "mp4", "webm", "gif" (first 30 s, 480 px wide),
    "mp3", "m4a" or "wav" (the audio formats extract the soundtrack).

tools.name: video_extract_frames
tools.description:
Grab still frames as PNG images. Either times_s = [seconds, ...] (up to 20) or count = N evenly
    spaced frames (1-20). Returns a list of image URLs, useful for thumbnails or for looking at a video.

tools.name: video_add_audio
tools.description:
Put a soundtrack on a video. mode = "replace" (new audio only) or "mix" (blend with the original).
    The audio is cut to the video's length. audio_volume 0.0-2.0 scales the added track.

tools.name: hire_for_task
tools.description:
Hire Gragg Robotics (a small US AI-automation company: an AI agent team plus its founder) to do a one-off
    job you or your user need done. Fixed prices:
      size="small"  $99  (1-2 business days): a script, spreadsheet, data cleanup/conversion, research brief,
                         video edi

tools.name: request_tool
tools.description:
Ask for a hosted tool that does not exist here yet (anything from email to video/audio/document work).
    Say what it should do, give an example input, what you would pay per use, and how often you would use it.
    We build tools that have paying demand; with a contact_email we confirm the price b

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: video_extract_frames · Private data: video_info, request_tool · Public sink: request_tool · Destructive: video_convert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: video_extract_frames · Private data: video_info, request_tool · Public sink: request_tool · Destructive: video_convert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
